adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null`). Immediately after, for collective team events the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars);` which becomes a no-op when `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, dropping all collected team member destination calendars. This is verifiable from the diff and can change behavior (team members’ destination calendars not applied). The diff also doesn’t add coverage for this edge case.
